name: @johnmorrisdotca/kuni
description: Kuni 国 — Countries, states and provinces: ISO 3166 codes and English/Japanese names, subdivisions, country facts and groupings, typed lookups, on-demand country data and an optional card. Zero dependencies.
author: John Morris

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsup
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && node scripts/check-package.mjs
scripts.test:demo: pnpm site && node scripts/docs-site.mjs build && playwright test
